name: Bruno Sterzi
bio: Count Antonio 'Bruno' Sterzi of Milan, a paper-mill owner and one of the private patrons Enzo Ferrari leaned on when the factory could not afford to race everywhere itself. He won the first Coppa Intereuropa at Monza in 1949 in a 166 S, and took the Coppa della Toscana and the Bolzano-Mendola hillclimb in 1952. Seventeenth in the 1955 Mille Miglia in a Maserati A6GCS, sharing with Vigano.
